Assemble a final manifest /tmp/var_count_workspace/final_ready_manifest.txt that includes the normalized listing reference, per-directory counts, permission issues, transformation log, reconciliation report, and checksum, preparing everything for a single final operation to derive the total number of files.

{"script":"# 1. Workspace
mkdir -p /tmp/var_count_workspace
rm -rf /tmp/var_count_workspace/*

# 2. Raw listing
find /var > /tmp/var_count_workspace/raw_listing.txt 2>&1

# 3. Normalize
grep "^/" /tmp/var_count_workspace/raw_listing.txt | sort -u > /tmp/var_count_workspace/normalized_listing.txt
echo "Normalized by extracting absolute paths and sorting unique entries." > /tmp/var_count_workspace/transform_log.txt

# 4. Permission issues
grep "Permission denied" /tmp/var_count_workspace/raw_listing.txt > /tmp/var_count_workspace/permission_issues.txt || true

# 5. Reconciliation (simplified for this environment)
echo "No recoveries attempted." > /tmp/var_count_workspace/reconciliation_report.txt

# 6. Counts and Checksum
cat /tmp/var_count_workspace/normalized_listing.txt | xargs -n1 dirname 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2 "," $1}' > /tmp/var_count_workspace/per_dir_counts.csv
sha256sum /tmp/var_count_workspace/normalized_listing.txt > /tmp/var_count_workspace/normalized_listing.checksum

# 7. Final Manifest
{
  echo "Manifest for /var file count"
